name: Normals Shader
definition: A shader that converts surface normals (typically in [-1, 1] range) to a visual representation (e.g., [0, 1] range) for output.
summary: The Normals Shader visualizes surface normals as emission colors by mapping vector components from [-1, 1] to [0, 1], serving as a debugging tool distinct from rotational or gradient-based shading methods.
